name: Plugable Dual 4K Display Docking Station UD-6950Z
source_title: Plugable UD-6950Z Product Specifications and Manual
excerpt: Dual 4K Display Horizontal Docking Station with DisplayLink DL-6950. Connects via USB-C or USB 3.0 Type-A. Dual 4K 60Hz HDMI or DisplayPort outputs. 6x USB 3.0 ports, Gigabit Ethernet. Powered by included 20V/2.5A power adapter (does not charge host PC).

evidence_excerpts.category: Plugable classifies the UD-6950Z as a universal docking station.
evidence_excerpts.host_connection: Includes USB-C to USB-C cable and USB-A to USB-C adapter.
evidence_excerpts.requires_usb_c_dp_alt_mode: Uses DisplayLink USB graphics; does not require DisplayPort Alternate Mode.
evidence_excerpts.hdmi_port_count: Dual 4K outputs via 2x HDMI 2.0 or 2x DisplayPort 1.2 ports.
evidence_excerpts.display_configurations: Supports simultaneous dual 4K displays at 60Hz in extended mode.
